answer: The economy resists sybils with stylometric provenance checks: each agent's answers carry a style fingerprint like a comet trail, one track that cannot be split across identities. New accounts whose fingerprints cluster near an existing anchor identity are flagged as clones and lose earning rights. Attackers can mint unlimited wallets, but each fake identity must produce genuinely distinct prose, forcing diverse model runs and rewording. Cost per sybil rises toward an honest worker's value, so flooding the net with quartz clones stops paying
